messages:
Priya: Heads up 1: our webhook processor pushed a batch of invoices with currency=USD but amounts in cents that look like they were converted using stale FX rates. NetSuite is creating duplicate invoices for some EUR accounts. Anyone on payments see this?

Marco: I saw alerts. NetSuite returns 409 DUPLICATE_INVOICE for some IDs, but for others it accepted and created a new invoice in USD instead of EUR. Looks like the Stripe->internal transform applied a conversion step conditionally.

Lina: Example payload from webhook queue (raw):

```json
{
  "id": "inv_9Qx",
  "customer": "cus_EUR123",
  "currency": "USD",
  "lines": [ { "description": "feature_x", "amount_cents": 1250 } ]
}
```

Lina: But Stripe's original invoice was currency=EUR and amount 11.25 EUR. Somewhere the converter ran when customer locale=EU and export target=NetSuite, producing USD row.

Priya: How did currency flip happen? We should never rewrite currency during export. It should use the canonical invoice currency from Stripe.

Marco: Tracked it to a recent change in billing-transform that attempted to normalize amounts into a platform_currency for internal analytics. There was a flag normalize_to_platform=true that should be isolated to analytics path, but a change accidentally threaded it into the export pipeline.

Zoe: That explains the duplicates. NetSuite uses customer_nexus to pick currency; when we sent USD for EUR accounts, NS created separate USD invoices instead of linking to EUR customer records, causing revenue split in accounting.

billing-bot: webhook-processor: 2026-04-04 02:10 UTC - processed batch 855 - 14 invoice exports; 4 flagged with currency_mismatch, 2 created duplicates in NetSuite.

Marco: Hotfix in progress: revert the threading of normalize_to_platform flag out of the export codepath. Also add an invariant check: export_currency == stripe_currency before emit.

Lina: I pushed a branch with the revert and an assertion in the exporter: `if export.currency != source.currency { throw new Error("currency_mismatch_in_export") }` and a unit test.

Priya: Good. Can we pause the export workers and put a hold on re-emitting until we confirm the fix? Finance is placing temporary holds on reconciliation for impacted accounts. Created TICKET-4357: "Currency normalization leaked into export -> NetSuite duplicate EUR/USD invoices".

finance-bot: quarantine-queue: 6 invoices moved to currency-quarantine-2026-04-04.

Zoe: Remediation plan: 1) pause exports (done?), 2) deploy hotfix to canary and verify that exported currency matches Stripe for 100 sample invoices in EU region, 3) re-run a dedupe reconciliation: for invoices created in wrong currency, create reversal/credit and re-emit correct invoice, 4) accounting to approve reversal journal entries.

Priya: I've paused the exporter workers (job id: export-2026-04-04) and flagged top-3 impacted customers for manual outreach if CS sees them. Finance will review reversal entries and sign the accounting adjustment template.

Marco: Canary metrics: exporter-canary 100 samples passed assertion. No currency_mismatch errors in canary.

Lina: I'll run a dry-run of the dedupe script that finds pairs (stripe_id matches, different currency) and outputs recommended actions. Putting dry-run results in TICKET-4357.

billing-bot: dedupe-dryrun: found 8 candidate pairs, recommended 6 reversals + 2 merges.

Priya: Finance will approve the 6 reversal templates. For the 2 merges, need NetSuite admin review. Sam (ns-admin) please advise on safe merge window.

Zoe: Follow-ups: 1) add CI guard to disallow normalize flag leaking into export path, 2) add monitoring alert: >3 currency_mismatch errors in an export run triggers auto-pause, 3) postmortem and rollout checklist for flags that cross service boundaries.

Marco: Agreed. Also we should scan recent deploys for other feature flags accidentally passed through context.

Priya: Thanks team. I'll update TICKET-4357 with finance sign-offs and coordinate customer comms if CS asks. If anyone sees support pings about duplicate invoices, escalate to me.

Lina: Dry-run results attached to the ticket. Will schedule a short maintenance window for re-emit after sign-off.

Priya: Postmortem scheduled tomorrow morning. Good catch, Lina and Marco. :white_check_mark:
